method: Actual parent browser scripts executed in Node VM with minimal DOM/events/FormData and synthetic Web API responses; actual prebuilt generator executed in memory; actual Worker imported with mocked ASSETS. No browser layout, live provider, cloud deployment or full build.
fixtures: All provider prices/models and approval implications are synthetic. Prebuilt specifications are the existing researched source data.
fixtureLimitations: Countries are standard header fixtures; morning region event tests explicitly simulate shared region storage change.
All prebuilt controller tests use the actual generated markup without control injection.
